svg.title: SWE-bench Verified pass rates with 95 percent confidence intervals
svg.desc: Cleveland dot plot on a white background. Opus 4.5 leads at 80.9 percent. Confidence intervals overlap heavily across all six models. Only the Opus 4.5 to Opus 4.1 difference reaches statistical significance.
svg.text: Pass rate on 500 verified tasks. Whiskers show 95% Wilson confidence intervals.

g.text: Whiskers overlap across all model pairs. Pairwise z-tests on the difference of proportions:
Opus 4.5 vs Opus 4.1, p ≈ 0.02 (significant). Opus 4.5 vs GPT-5.1-Codex-Max, p ≈ 0.24 (not significant).
Gemini 3 Pro vs GPT-5.1 differ by 0.1 pp — within rounding.
Source: SWE-bench Verified, n=500 tasks per model. Confidence intervals computed via Wilson method, α=0.05.
